description.zh: fscan 是内网综合扫描工具，一条命令完成主机存活、端口、常见服务弱口令、Redis 未授权、MS17-010 与 Web 指纹批量探测，护网内网横向阶段的高频首选。
description.en: Fscan is an all-in-one intranet scanner covering host discovery, port scanning, common service weak credentials, Redis unauthenticated access, MS17-010, and web fingerprinting in a single run — a go-to for intranet lateral phases.

description.zh: 对网段做存活 + 端口 + 常见漏洞 + 弱口令的一把梭扫描，内网立足后第一轮摸底。
description.en: Run host discovery, ports, common vulns, and weak credentials across the subnet — the first sweep after foothold.

description.zh: 只扫高频服务端口，控制流量与耗时。
description.en: Scan only high-frequency service ports to bound traffic and runtime.

description.zh: 跳过 Web 指纹（-nw）聚焦服务弱口令与未授权，Redis 6379 命中即标记。
description.en: Skip web fingerprinting (-nw) and focus on service weak credentials and unauthenticated services such as Redis 6379.

description.zh: 指定模块做 SSH/MySQL/SMB 口令批量校验，-pwda 追加自带口令字典。
description.en: Run SSH/MySQL/SMB credential checks with -m and extend the built-in password list via -pwda.

description.zh: 扫描结果写入文件，便于横向阶段回查与报告取证。
description.en: Write results to a file for lateral-movement follow-up and reporting.

installation.zh: 从 GitHub Releases 下载对应平台二进制（Windows/Linux/macOS），无需依赖直接运行。
installation.en: Download the platform binary from GitHub Releases (Windows/Linux/macOS); no dependencies required.

description.zh: pypykatz 是 mimikatz 的纯 Python 实现，离线解析 LSASS 转储提取明文口令、NTLM 哈希、Kerberos 票据与 DPAPI 材料，无需 Windows 环境即可在攻击机上完成凭据提取。
description.en: pypykatz is a pure-Python mimikatz implementation that parses LSASS dumps offline to extract plaintext credentials, NTLM hashes, Kerberos tickets, and DPAPI material — credential extraction on the attack box without Windows.

name.zh: 离线解析 LSASS 转储

description.zh: 解析 minidump 格式的 LSASS 转储，输出全部登录会话的凭据材料。
description.en: Parse a minidump-format LSASS dump and print credentials for every logon session.

description.zh: 结构化输出便于脚本化提取特定会话的哈希。
description.en: Structured output for scripted extraction of specific session hashes.

description.zh: 只打印 Kerberos 段：TGT/TGS 与密钥，供票据传递复用。
description.en: Print only the Kerberos section (TGT/TGS and keys) for pass-the-ticket reuse.

description.zh: 配合 SYSTEM hive 解析 SAM，离线还原本地账户 NTLM 哈希。
description.en: Parse SAM with its SYSTEM hive to recover local-account NTLM hashes offline.

description.zh: 在授权实验 Windows 主机上直接读活动 LSASS（需本地管理员），实验环境替代性验证用。
description.en: Read the live LSASS on an authorized lab Windows host (local admin required) as a lab-side verification alternative.

description.zh: Coercer 自动化对 Windows 机器账号发起多种强制认证调用（Printerbug/DFSCoerce/_petitpotam 系列等十余种），用于验证 SMB 签名与 LDAP 通道绑定配置——中继攻击面的前置核查工具。
description.en: Coercer automates a dozen coerced-authentication calls (Printerbug, DFSCoerce, PetitPotam family, and more) against Windows machine accounts to verify SMB signing and LDAP channel binding — the pre-check for relay attack surface.

description.zh: 对目标机器账号逐一尝试全部强制认证方法，回调落到监听端即确认对应方法可用。
description.en: Try every coercion method against the target machine account; any callback on the listener confirms that method works.

description.zh: 先探测目标开放的认证协议（SMB/HTTP/WebDAV），缩小可用方法集。
description.en: Probe which auth protocols (SMB/HTTP/WebDAV) the target exposes to narrow the usable method set.

description.zh: 只发指定方法（如 DFSCoerceV2），配合单一变量验证签名配置结论。
description.en: Fire one named method (e.g. DFSCoerceV2) to validate a single-variable conclusion about signing configuration.

description.zh: dnSpy 是 .NET 程序集反编译与动态调试器，可查看 C#/VB 反编译源码、下断点、改 IL 并即时保存——审计 .NET 红队工具、破解客户端逻辑、调试 PowerShell 加载的托管 DLL 的主力工具。
description.en: dnSpy decompiles and debugs .NET assemblies: read C#/VB sources, set breakpoints, patch IL, and save edits in place — the workhorse for auditing .NET red-team tooling, unpacking client logic, and debugging managed DLLs loaded by PowerShell.

description.zh: 32 位调试目标用 dnSpy-x86.exe，纯查看用 dnSpy.exe 均可拖入或命令行打开。
description.en: Use dnSpy-x86.exe for 32-bit debug targets; dnSpy.exe opens any assembly for inspection.

description.zh: 把程序集导出为可编译的 csproj 工程，便于全文检索与 diff 审计。
description.en: Export the assembly as a compilable csproj project for full-text search and diff-based audit.

description.zh: 启动后在 Debug 菜单附加运行中的托管进程（实验室授权环境内），断点看参数与内存——PID 调试时手工填入。
description.en: Start dnSpy and attach the running managed process via the Debug menu inside the authorized lab, breaking on arguments and memory — the PID is filled in at debug time.

installation.zh: 从 GitHub Releases 下载 dnSpy 或 dnSpyEx（社区维护分支）zip 解压即用，需 .NET Framework 4.x 运行时。
installation.en: Unzip the dnSpy or dnSpyEx (community fork) release; requires the .NET Framework 4.x runtime.

description.zh: hashclash 是 MD5/SHA1 选择前缀碰撞研究工具集（Marc Stevens），pcollide/unihash 等组件用于构造同源不同哈希manifest 的文件对，验证签名与完整性校验对碰撞攻击的抵抗面。
description.en: hashclash is Marc Stevens' MD5/SHA1 chosen-prefix collision toolset; components like pcollide build file pairs sharing a prefix yet differing in hash to test how signatures and integrity checks resist collision attacks.

description.zh: 对两个期望前缀构造 MD5 碰撞块，输出可拼接的碰撞字节段。
description.en: Build an MD5 collision block for two desired prefixes and emit the spliceable collision bytes.

description.zh: 把碰撞段拼进合法文件模板，得到哈希不同但前缀受控的文件对。
description.en: Splice the collision block into a benign template to produce the prefix-controlled file pair.

description.zh: 核对文件对 MD5 一致而内容不同，即碰撞成立。
description.en: Confirm the pair shares an MD5 while differing in content — collision achieved.

installation.zh: 源码构建：git clone https://github.com/cr-marcstevens/hashclash && 依赖 boost 与 cmake，按 README 构建；常用 Docker 镜像托管。
installation.en: Build from source: git clone https://github.com/cr-marcstevens/hashclash (needs boost and cmake per README); Docker images are commonly used.

description.zh: Inveigh 是 PowerShell/.NET 的 Windows 中间人毒化工具（LLMNR/mDNS/NBNS + HTTP/SMB 捕获），在无法上传二进制的 Windows 阵地用 PowerShell 托管代码捕获 Net-NTLMv2 挑战。
description.en: Inveigh is the PowerShell/.NET Windows spoofer (LLMNR/mDNS/NBNS plus HTTP/SMB capture) for catching Net-NTLMv2 challenges with managed code when no binary can be staged.

commands.command: powershell -exec bypass -c "Import-Module .\Inveigh.ps1; Invoke-Inveigh -ConsoleOutput Y -NBNS Y -LLMNR Y"

description.zh: 开启 LLMNR/NBNS 毒化并控制台输出捕获到的挑战，授权实验网段内使用。
description.en: Enable LLMNR/NBNS poisoning with console capture output, inside the authorized lab segment.

description.zh: -Tool 2 切换 C# 编译版（Inveigh Zero），触发更稳、AMSI 面更小。
description.en: Switch to the C# edition (Inveigh Zero) via -Tool 2 for steadier triggers and a smaller AMSI surface.

description.zh: 捕获写入指定目录（挑战哈希供 hashcat 离线破解），实验后清理。
description.en: Write captures to a directory (hashes for offline hashcat), cleaned up after the lab.

installation.zh: 从 GitHub Releases 下载 Inveigh.ps1 或 InveighZero 编译版；PowerShell 版免安装，目标机需 .NET 4.5+。
installation.en: Download Inveigh.ps1 or the compiled InveighZero from GitHub Releases; the PowerShell edition needs no install, targets require .NET 4.5+.
